assessment.label: misalignment
assessment.reason: Query shows low 1x (~0.0009-0.0013) on all 4 channels, similar to normal and misalignment references, not the elevated 1x (~0.004-0.015) seen in unbalance and looseness references. Query shows elevated 2x on channels 0 (0.00989) and 2 (0.00828) with lower 2x on channels 1 (0.00240) and 3 (0.00153). This channel-selective 2x dominance matches labelled misalignment trials (e.g., 2x ~0.014-0.015 on ch0/ch2 with 1x <0.0011, and 2x ~0.001-0.002 on ch1/ch3) and exceeds 2x seen in normal trials. Kurtosis ~3.2-3.8 and crest ~4.5-5.5 are non-impulsive, consistent with misalignment/normal, not diagnostic alone. Limitation: radial signals and one short recording may not uniquely distinguish faults; assessment based only on supplied features vs same-rig references.
